title: Marmaray, Eurasia Tunnel and Istanbul connect crossings with municipal services
summary: Two operating transport projects and one municipality distinguish design, reported use, concession structure and service access. Eligibility reaches 92 projects and 62 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Eighteen official English/Turkish records inspected November 22: thirteen HTML bodies or scoped segments and five explicitly bounded indexed records after direct timeouts. Opening, design, reported use, future relief and service eligibility remain distinct.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
